Definition: feminine of G4552; Sapphire, an Israelitess:--Sapphira.
BiblicalUsage: Sapphira is an Israelitess, the wife of Ananias. You find the name in Acts 5:1: "…certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife…" — in the SBL text the name stands as Σάπφιρα.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sapphira matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
